description: Catch-up sync for an agent that was offline: returns every provenance event after the given sequence number, so the agent replays exactly what it missed. Store the returned headSeq and pass it as sinceSeq next time. For human-style reading of recent activity, bus_events is the simpler view of the same log.

agent.description: Optional: your agent name. On a bus that enforces agent tokens, pass it with token to include your own direct messages; without proof only broadcasts are visible.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return in one call.

sinceSeq.description: Return events with a sequence number greater than this. 0 replays from the beginning.

name: bus_sync
